title: Keep provider aliases at the route boundary
capture_reason: A verified routing convention should remain discoverable near related normalization guidance.

content.context: Provider aliases are accepted from callers but canonical identifiers drive routing.
content.guidance: Resolve aliases once at the route boundary and keep the registry canonical.
content.why_it_matters: Scattered alias handling makes route evidence and fallbacks inconsistent.
content.boundaries: This applies to provider identity, not model-version aliases owned by provider adapters.
content.examples: Good: map an alias before registry lookup. Counterexample: duplicate alias keys throughout the registry.

claims.statement: The routing guide treats provider failure as control flow.
claims.source_quote: Provider failure is ordinary control flow.
